notes.subject: חמוץ
notes.rationale: yo a khutlwago ('the oppressed') kgahlanong le 'yo a khutlwago a feleletša ke molala' ('correct the oppressor', BSB); lentšu le bolela 'yo a nonago ka tlhaolelo', gomme kgokgano le go thoma ga lona e latela phethagatšo ya go šegofatša.

notes.subject: משפט/שפטו
notes.rationale: leme le le tee š-פ-ט le tšwela gabedi — 'toka' le 'aholeng' — kgokagano ye e laolang setshwano sa setseko, e sa bonagale ka botlalo.

notes.subject: setšhaba sa Juda
notes.rationale: maelelo a boitshwaro a go bitša (go ithuta, go nyaka, go šegofatša, go ahlola, go lwa) go banababo ba Juda.

translation: Ithuteng go dira se sengwe se lokilego, nyakeng toka, šegofatšeng yo a khutlwago, aholeng ⟨את⟩ hlogwana, lweleng ⟨את⟩ mofelwa.

tokens.gloss: go dira se sengwe se lokilego
